fullPassage: Maybe you've heard this joke: "How do you eat an elephant?" The answer is "one bite at a time." So, how do you "build" the Earth? That's simple, too: one atom at a time. Atoms are the basic building blocks of crystals, and since all rocks are made up of crystals, the more you know about atoms, the better. Crystals come in a variety of shapes that scientists call habits. Common crystal habits include squares, triangles, and six-sided hexagons. Usually crystals form when liquids cool, such as when you create ice cubes. Many times, crystals form in ways that do not allow for perfect shapes. If conditions are too cold, too hot, or there isn't enough source material, they can form strange, twisted shapes. But when conditions are right, we see beautiful displays. Usually, this involves a slow, steady environment where the individual atoms have plenty of time to join and fit perfectly into what's known as the crystal lattice. This is the basic structure of atoms that is seen time after time.

밑줄 'If conditions are too cold, too hot, ... <u>they</u> can form strange, twisted shapes' — they는 앞서 언급된 crystals(결정).
❌ ① 조건들: 모양을 형성하는 주체 아님
✅ ② 결정들: crystals form ... they can form ← 정답
❌ ③ 원자들: 결정을 이루는 요소
❌ ④ 암석들: 문맥상 결정
det.tip: they = crystals(모양을 형성하는 주체)

questions.passage: Maybe you've heard this joke: "How do you eat an elephant?" The answer is "one bite at a time." So, how do you "build" the Earth? That's simple, too: one atom at a time. Atoms are the basic building blocks of crystals, and since all rocks are made up of crystals, the more you know about atoms, the better. Crystals come in a variety of shapes that scientists call habits. Common crystal habits include squares, triangles, and six-sided hexagons. Usually crystals form when liquids cool, such as when you create ice cubes. Many times, crystals form in ways that do not allow for perfect shapes. If conditions are too cold, too hot, or there isn't enough source material, they can form strange, twisted shapes. But when conditions are right, we see beautiful displays. Usually, this involves __________ where the individual atoms have plenty of time to join and fit perfectly into what's known as the crystal lattice. This is the basic structure of atoms that is seen time after time.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 빈칸에 a slow, steady environment(느리고 안정된 환경)가 적절
det.analysis:
❌ ① a sudden burst of heat(갑작스러운 열): 빠른 변화와 반대
❌ ② a crowded, noisy space(붐비는 공간): 본문에 없음
❌ ③ a short, intense reaction(짧고 강한 반응): 느림과 반대
✅ ④ a slow, steady environment(느리고 안정된 환경): 원자가 결합할 시간이 충분한 환경 ← 정답
det.tip: slow, steady environment → atoms have time to join and fit perfectly
